mechanismOfAction.summary: Sodium channel blocker (local anesthetic) + relatively potent monoamine transporter inhibition (DA/NE/5-HT reuptake) — stimulant properties distinguish it from purely local-anesthetic benzoates.
mechanismOfAction.description: Aminoester (benzoate) local anesthetic; dimethocaine-related (4-aminobenzoate scaffold). Historical dental anesthetic. Unlike purely local-anesthetic benzoates, meprylcaine also inhibits DA, NE, and 5-HT reuptake transporters, generating stimulant properties. Aminoester structure → rapid hydrolysis; short-acting. No recreational dose ranges established.
